summary: Proposal keeps the closure correction bounded to exactly two chmod(0o000)-based unreadable Guidance fixture tests plus one narrow MODIFIED Formal Full Test platform-fixture requirement. Actual capability probe, not OS name or mode bits, decides whether the fixture is enforceable. Capability-bound SKIP remains explicit project-local accounting only and is never semantic PASS; same-candidate real enforcement proof remains required. No Core skipped status/evidence subsystem, production resolver change, ACL/filesystem abstraction, sixth planned capability or D05 is introduced. Fresh native-Windows proof is mandatory after Apply.
